senses.definition: rim (or part of the rim) into which spokes are inserted

quotations.old_english: Æ-acute;lces spácan biþ óðer ende fæst on ðare nafe, óðer on ðære felge
quotations.english: one end of every spoke is fixed in the nave, the other in the felly

quotations.old_english: Ða felga hangiaþ on ðám spácan
quotations.english: the fellies depend on the spokes

quotations.old_english: Ðæt hweól hwerfþ ymbúton, and sió nafa, néhst ðære eaxe, sió færþ micle fæstlícor and orsorglícor ðonne ða felgan dón
quotations.english: the wheel turns round, and the nave, being nearest to the axle-tree, goes much more firmly and more securely than the fellies do
